_doc: Pixel positions used to annotate figures. Measured in the game by drawing a debug sphere (MCP debug_draw) at the map coordinate, taking a calibration screenshot (not kept) and averaging the magenta pixels. Aerial: 5 spheres r=9 m; others: r=0.25 m. null = sphere hidden under the road surface (label placed visually next to the word).
_aerial_model: vertical FOV 50 deg, pinhole; projected vs measured error <= 6 px
